from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1'
assert not (OUT/'result.json').exists(),'E3来源裁决已存在，不能覆盖。'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def clean(v):
 if isinstance(v,dict):return {str(k):clean(x) for k,x in v.items()}
 if isinstance(v,(list,tuple,np.ndarray)):return [clean(x) for x in v]
 if isinstance(v,(np.integer,)):return int(v)
 if isinstance(v,(np.bool_,)):return bool(v)
 if isinstance(v,(pd.Timestamp,datetime)):return v.isoformat()
 if isinstance(v,(float,np.floating)):return float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else None
 return v
def save(name,d):(OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(clean(d),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def csv(name,f):f.to_csv(OUT/name,index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
protocol=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));freeze=json.loads((OUT/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert sha(OUT/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
for name,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==h,name
source_receipts=json.loads((OUT/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sources=source_receipts['items'];assert len(sources)==11
for s in sources:
 if s['status']=='OFFICIAL_CONTENT_CHECKED':assert sha(ROOT/s['source_path'])==s['source_sha256']
catalog=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_factor96_issuance_catalogue_v1'
unique=pd.read_parquet(catalog/'unique_documents.parquet')
occurrences=pd.read_parquet(catalog/'catalogue_occurrences.parquet')
windows=pd.read_parquet(catalog/'query_windows.parquet')
old=json.loads((catalog/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(unique)==old['unique_issuer_documents']==74129
assert len(occurrences)==old['source_occurrences']==90500
assert len(windows)==old['query_jobs']==987
assert len(unique.drop_duplicates(['symbol','document_id']))==len(unique)
role_counts=unique.title_role.value_counts().to_dict()
assert role_counts==old['title_roles']
complete=int(windows.complete.fillna(False).sum());assert complete==old['complete_jobs']==953
years=pd.to_datetime(unique.catalogue_date).dt.year
year_rows=[]
for year in range(2015,2026):
 block=unique[years.eq(year)]
 year_rows.append({'year':year,'unique_issuer_documents':len(block),'document_issuers':block.symbol.nunique(),
                   'ipo_title_documents':int(block.title_role.eq('IPO_OUTSIDE_M06_CORE').sum()),
                   'issuer_calendar_document_candidates':int(block.title_role.eq('ISSUER_CALENDAR_DOCUMENT_CANDIDATE').sum()),
                   'termination_or_rejection_titles':int(block.title_role.eq('TERMINATION_OR_REJECTION_CANDIDATE').sum()),
                   'cash_amount_numeric_fields':0,'verified_funds_settlement_dates':0,
                   'title_counts_are_economic_event_counts':False})
csv('旧目录逐年来源范围.csv',pd.DataFrame(year_rows))
csv('旧目录未完成检索任务.csv',windows[~windows.complete.fillna(False)])
csv('旧目录角色计数.csv',pd.DataFrame([{'title_role':k,'documents':v,'trading_feature_admitted':False} for k,v in role_counts.items()]))
catalogue_result={
'registered_universe':'2015—2025每日点时沪深300成员历史并集，不是全市场IPO/再融资总体',
'registered_companies':old['historical_member_companies'],'document_issuers':int(unique.symbol.nunique()),
'query_jobs':len(windows),'complete_jobs':complete,'incomplete_jobs':len(windows)-complete,
'query_complete_fraction':complete/len(windows),'source_occurrences':len(occurrences),'unique_documents':len(unique),
'cross_query_duplicate_occurrences':len(occurrences)-len(unique),'title_roles':role_counts,
'ipo_title_documents':int(unique.title_role.eq('IPO_OUTSIDE_M06_CORE').sum()),
'cash_amount_fields_present':False,'project_acceptance_status_fields_present':False,
'verified_payment_or_settlement_date_fields_present':False,
'full_economic_issuance_calendar_established':False,'all_market_population_established':False,
'first_publication_verified_documents':int(unique.historical_first_publication_verified.fillna(False).sum()),
'trading_feature_admitted_documents':int(unique.trading_feature_admitted.fillna(False).sum()),
'issuer_universe_and_query_gaps_retained':True,'further_security_document_downloads':0}
save('旧发行目录资格核对.json',catalogue_result)
def compact(s):
 return re.sub(r'\s+','',s).replace('“','').replace('”','').replace('，',',')
by_id={s['id']:s for s in sources}
texts={s['id']:compact((ROOT/s['source_path']).with_suffix('.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for s in sources if s['status']=='OFFICIAL_CONTENT_CHECKED'}
facts=[
{'id':'NO_IPO_SWITCH_OFF','source':'not_closed_clarification','phrases':['IPO受理、审核、注册等相关工作没有暂停','不存在IPO关闸的情况','再融资也不存在关闸情况'],'finding':'收紧是节奏安排；不等同停止所有IPO或再融资。','field_consequence':'不能以停止发行=1或政策后融资额=0构造状态。'},
{'id':'PROJECT_GRANDFATHERING_SSE','source':'sse_refinancing_details','phrases':['适用于实施后新受理的项目','前期已受理、目前处于审核阶段的项目,不适用'],'finding':'新受理与已受理在审项目有不同适用安排。','field_consequence':'需项目受理状态和时点，不能按同一日对全部发行金额减计。'},
{'id':'PROJECT_GRANDFATHERING_SZSE','source':'szse_refinancing_details','phrases':['适用于实施后新受理的项目','前期已受理、目前处于审核阶段的项目,不适用'],'finding':'深圳同样区分新受理和已受理项目。','field_consequence':'与上海同日同根解释，不是新增独立市场冲击。'},
{'id':'SIMPLIFIED_EXCEPTION','source':'sse_refinancing_details','phrases':['不超过3亿元且不超过净资产的20%','采用简易程序的再融资不适用破发、破净、经营业绩持续亏损'],'finding':'小规模简易程序存在相关限制例外。','field_consequence':'需融资规模、净资产、程序信息，目录标题不足。'},
{'id':'TARGETED_AND_STRATEGIC_EXCEPTIONS','source':'sse_refinancing_details','phrases':['符合国家重大战略方向的再融资不适用','董事会确定全部发行对象的再融资不适用'],'finding':'战略项目和确定发行对象存在不同适用要求；不是全部再融资同幅收缩。','field_consequence':'需发行对象、用途及适用安排，不能机械推算全市场资金节省。'},
{'id':'LOSS_SPACING','source':'sse_refinancing_details','phrases':['最近两个会计年度','不得低于十八个月'],'finding':'连续亏损相关融资间隔要求不同于所有公司统一暂停。','field_consequence':'需当时财务、前次到位和本次董事会日期；审批、预案、缴款不同。'},
{'id':'REAL_ESTATE_EXCEPTION','source':'supply_tightening','phrases':['房地产上市公司再融资不受破发、破净和亏损限制'],'finding':'原安排明确房地产例外。','field_consequence':'不能由全部破净比例直接估算被限制融资额。'},
{'id':'PAYMENT_AFTER_ALLOCATION','source':'subscription_reform_announcement','phrases':['将申购时预先缴款改为确定配售数量后再进行缴款','相关规则修订和技术系统改造工作均需要一定的准备时间'],'finding':'宣布取消预缴与正式过渡不同；申购数量不等同获配缴款数量。','field_consequence':'预缴改革公告仅作历史机制背景，不当2015-11-06即时全实施。'},
{'id':'PAYMENT_CLOCK','source':'subscription_settlement_qa','phrases':['原T+1日申购资金验资环节取消','T+2日日终有足额的新股认购资金','T+3日','扣除承销费用后划给发行人'],'finding':'申购、确定获配、缴款、交收及发行人到账是不同环节。','field_consequence':'资金占用需数量价格与支付日，不能用IPO日或目录发布日期代替。'},
{'id':'REGISTRATION_ANTICIPATION','source':'registration_transition','phrases':['2023年2月1日,全面实行股票发行注册制改革正式启动','已向社会公开征求意见'],'finding':'2月17日正式实施前已有改革公开信息。','field_consequence':'不能把2月17日当作完全意外的新供给冲击。'},
{'id':'QUALITY_DRAFT_NOT_FINAL','source':'quality_draft_details','phrases':['规则草案公开征求意见','履行程序后发布实施'],'finding':'部分规则先草案再实施；同日也含退市、减持、券商与交易监管。','field_consequence':'不以4月12日将所有拟议标准视为已生效，不单独归因IPO。'},
{'id':'GUIDANCE_NOT_FUNDS','source':'quality_issuance_guidance','phrases':['即日起实施','融资必要性'],'finding':'指引改善披露和行为要求，没有给出全市场实际资金占用减量。','field_consequence':'不能把披露规则更新当确定的现金流入股市。'}]
fact_rows=[]
for fact in facts:
 s=by_id[fact['source']]
 if s['status']!='OFFICIAL_CONTENT_CHECKED':
  fact_rows.append({**fact,'status':'SOURCE_NOT_ADMITTED','source_url':s['url']});continue
 missing=[phrase for phrase in fact['phrases'] if compact(phrase) not in texts[fact['source']]]
 assert not missing,(fact['id'],missing)
 fact_rows.append({**fact,'status':'CONFIRMED_SOURCE_SCOPE_FACT','source_url':s['url'],'source_sha256':s['source_sha256'],
                   'original_body_date':s['date'],'model_field_admitted':False,
                   'historical_first_vintage_verified':False})
save('规则范围与支付环节事实.json',fact_rows)
dated=[s for s in sources if s['status']=='OFFICIAL_CONTENT_CHECKED' and s['date'] and not s['family'].startswith('CONTEXT')]
timeline=pd.DataFrame([{'source_id':s['id'],'policy_family':s['family'],'stage':s['stage'],'original_body_date':s['date'],
                       'published_at_upper_bound':s['published_at_upper_bound'],'url':s['url'],
                       'numeric_cash_absorption_amount':None,'numeric_known_future_payment_date':None,
                       'source_sha256':s['source_sha256'],'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,
                       'first_publication_meta':json.dumps(s['page_time_meta'],ensure_ascii=False)} for s in dated])
csv('官方规则时间线.csv',timeline)
# 只读取已冻结事件元数据，不读取收益和市场价格列。
parent_path=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet'
events=pd.read_parquet(parent_path,columns=['stat_month','decision_at','era']).sort_values('decision_at')
connections=[]
for row in events.itertuples():
 available=[s for s in dated if pd.Timestamp(s['published_at_upper_bound'])<=row.decision_at]
 latest=max(available,key=lambda s:s['published_at_upper_bound']) if available else None
 roots=sorted(set(s['family'] for s in available))
 connections.append({'stat_month':row.stat_month,'decision_at':row.decision_at,'era':row.era,
                     'available_policy_source_pages':len(available),'distinct_policy_roots_known':len(roots),
                     'latest_policy_id':latest['id'] if latest else None,'latest_policy_family':latest['family'] if latest else None,
                     'latest_body_date':latest['date'] if latest else None,
                     'policy_clock_role':'按原文打印日期的事后重建连接；非首发接收认证',
                     'eligible_cash_absorption_feature':None,'feature_status':'NO_QUALIFIED_CONTINUOUS_EQUITY_SUPPLY_FIELD',
                     'new_stock_returns_read':False})
connections=pd.DataFrame(connections);csv('68月当时规则可知连接_不含收益.csv',connections)
migration=[]
for s in sources:
 for meta in s.get('page_time_meta',[]):
  if s['date'] and meta['content'][:10]>s['date']:
   migration.append({'source_id':s['id'],'original_body_date':s['date'],'page_meta_time':meta['content'],
                     'role':'站点重建时钟，不能当历史首发；原文打印日连接仍只是重建代理'})
save('原文日期与迁站元数据差异.json',migration)
gates={'different_mechanism_from_old_margin_net_change':True,
       'official_rules_and_applicability_defined':len(fact_rows)==12 and all(x['status']=='CONFIRMED_SOURCE_SCOPE_FACT' for x in fact_rows),
       'continuous_all_market_amount_and_payment_field_available':False,
       'project_level_applicability_and_settlement_dates_available':False,
       'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False}
unchanged={k:sha(ROOT/k)==h for k,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items()};assert all(unchanged.values())
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E3','completed_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
 'status':'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED_NO_CONTINUOUS_EQUITY_SUPPLY_FIELD',
 'classification':'PROGRESS_BOUNDED_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_COMPLETED_NO_NEW_SCORE',
 'official_sources_targeted':11,'official_sources_checked':sum(s['status']=='OFFICIAL_CONTENT_CHECKED' for s in sources),
 'context_sources':2,'dated_policy_sources':len(dated),'distinct_policy_publication_dates':timeline.original_body_date.nunique(),
 'policy_root_families':timeline.policy_family.nunique(),'rule_scope_facts':len(fact_rows),
 'event_metadata_connections':len(connections),'events_with_at_least_one_known_policy_page':int(connections.available_policy_source_pages.gt(0).sum()),
 'events_without_a_prior_page_in_bounded_route':int(connections.available_policy_source_pages.eq(0).sum()),
 'qualified_continuous_feature_events':0,'catalogue_qualification':catalogue_result,
 'admission_components':gates,'model_score_admission_passed':False,
 'model_score_status':'NOT_RUN_OWN_SOURCE_GATE','new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,
 'account_net_sharpe':None,'account_net_cagr':None,'goal_achieved':False,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'new_repository_code_edits':0,'new_market_downloads':0,'new_official_source_pages':11,
 'causal_effect_identified':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'conclusion':'规则提供真实的选择性供给约束事实，但没有连续全市场现金占用/实际供给金额；标题目录覆盖和时点不满足。收紧不是关闸，获配支付不是全量申购冻结，同政策多环节不独立。本来源路线结束，不把缺字段写成已回测亏损。',
 'next_research_question':'先去重已做美债名义/实质/通胀补偿研究，确认是否存在未测试的连续实质利率与通胀补偿原因状态、官方可用时点和同池对照；若只是旧表达或无法确定可用时点，不立新评分。'}
save('result.json',result)
save('必要来源核对.json',{'at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'input_hashes_unchanged':unchanged,
 'official_raw_hashes_verified':True,'fixed_source_count':11,'all_fixed_sources_accounted_for':True,
 'catalogue_counts_match_saved_result':True,'nonoverlapping_policy_roots_are_not_independent_experiments':True,
 'stock_returns_not_loaded_in_this_program':True,'zero_new_model_fits':True,'zero_new_accounts':True,
 'all_missing_amounts_and_dates_retained':True,'historical_first_vintage_verified':False})
print(json.dumps(clean({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='catalogue_qualification'}),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('旧目录准入：'+json.dumps(catalogue_result,ensure_ascii=False))
